market.question: Will the highest temperature in Chengdu be 23°C on April 30?

assessment.reasoning: Chengdu April 30 forecasts disagree: one shows high 75°F (~23.9°C) with rain, another shows 27°C morning high. April climatological average high in Chengdu is ~22-24°C. The 23°C bucket is near the central forecast but conflicting forecasts and near-boundary bucket make this a coin-flip among 22/23/24°C. Roughly equal probability among adjacent buckets.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether rain depresses peak temperature by ~2C or it warms toward 27C as some forecasts suggest
